dataset: Marine Regions World Maritime Boundaries v12 (2023)
processing: Select bilateral lines 3511, 3512 and 3513; clip to local GIS asset extent. Notebook clips to the displayed water geometry. No interpolation, smoothing, or inferred extension of boundary coordinates.
omitted_features: Baselines, connection lines and joint-regime perimeter 4104 are not sovereign-country divisions and are not shown.
status_note: Slovenia–Croatia follows the 2017 arbitral award and is disputed by Croatia; this is research context, not a declaration of agreed jurisdiction.

slovenian_display_mask.processing: Clip the source polygon to the GIS asset extent; intersect with displayed water in the notebook. Exclude it from rendered heatmaps only; raw cell counts and predictions remain unchanged.
slovenian_display_mask.status: Uses the source dataset's Slovenia polygon, consistent with its 2017 arbitral line representation; this display choice does not resolve the dispute.

italian_edge_smoothing_mask.processing: Clip to bundled GIS extent. Restrict inward opacity feathering to Italian water. Protect the coastline from the offshore grid fade; fade at enabled Italian bilateral sea-border masks with a 100 m clear display margin.

croatian_display_mask.processing: Clip source polygon to GIS asset extent; exclude from rendered heatmaps only, preserving raw counts and predictions.
